description: This file defines the vardefs array for the AOBH_BusinessHours module in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project. It specifies the database table 'aobh_businesshours', fields such as opening_hours, closing_hours, open_status, and day, and their properties, along with module metadata and relationship settings.

classes.description: A class responsible for creating vardefs dynamically for SugarCRM modules.

methods.description: Static method to generate vardef definitions for a specified module.
